title: Various logic errors in view processing can cause incorrect cached results to be returned. (CVE-2026-123761)
description: CVE-2026-123761 is a high-severity vulnerability involving various logic errors in view processing that can cause incorrect cached results to be returned. This flaw affects the integrity of data served from cache, potentially leading to incorrect information being presented to users or systems relying on the cached data. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 8.2, indicating a significant impact on data integrity with low attack complexity and no required privileges or user interaction.
